{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for customers who converted (converted == 1)
converted_customers = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Also compute count of converted customers
n_converted = len(converted_customers)

mean_age_converted, n_converted"}
